integrity: The exact-object literature supplies the clique decomposition of finite AC-group commuting graphs. The new conclusions are proved componentwise, including every minimum forcing set, exact minimum rank, equality with maximum nullity, and polynomial reconstruction of the clique-size multiset.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite nonabelian AC-groups.
The zero forcing polynomial determines the commuting graph and the noncentral-centralizer component sizes, not the group isomorphism type in general.
The center size and absolute centralizer orders need not be recoverable from the polynomial alone.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric matrices.
Generic zero-forcing-polynomial multiplicativity is prior graph-theoretic coverage and is not claimed as new.
title: Zero forcing polynomials completely recognize commuting graphs of finite AC-groups
